workflows.description: core contract, coverage, reasoning-log, and gate normalization checks.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered control_validation_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared control_validation_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by control_validation_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Audit Mathformer workflow contracts, routes, reasoning flows, skill coverage, and reasoning logs, then apply the repository gate policy.
reasoning_projection.name: ValidateMathformerControl

occurrences.rationale: Assess hook, owner, routing, and shared-runtime integrity against the canonical contract.
Assess whether every controlled workflow family remains reachable from natural language.
Assess typed handles, licensed relations, calibrated endpoints, and registry alignment.
Assess whether skills, hooks, owners, and named loops remain fully connected.
Assess reasoning-log structure, event identity, skill attribution, and hook identity.
Apply blocking and waiver policy without turning validation results into new evidence.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: criterion-scoped interpretation of deterministic control checks
